Name: Tractor Beam Auto Connect
Description:
[h2]Tractor Beam Auto Connect[/h2]

Ever rebuilt a Tractor Beam, reconnected the electrical grid, or replaced part of your ship only to discover that the beam has quietly forgotten where incoming objects are supposed to land? Well, have I got a very specific memory aid for you!

Tractor Beam Auto Connect watches for Tractor Beams that have lost their target assignment and reconnects them to eligible Tractor Beam Targets. It restores sensible working relationships without optimizing, rebalancing, or second-guessing assignments that already exist.

[h2]Features[/h2]

[h3]Automatic Assignment Recovery[/h3]
- Assigns only Tractor Beams that currently have no target
- Reacts when a Tractor Beam Target finishes construction
- Performs a validation pass shortly after loading a save
- Includes a lightweight ten-second fallback scan for grid reconnects, reconstruction, replacement, and other vanilla events that clear assignments
- Uses Stardeus's own Tractor Beam target-assignment method

[h3]Sensible Target Distribution[/h3]
- Prioritizes eligible targets that currently have no assigned Tractor Beam
- Spreads new assignments across available targets before reusing any target
- Chooses randomly when every eligible target is already represented
- Supports any number of Tractor Beams and Tractor Beam Targets

[h3]Persistent Controls[/h3]
- Adds a cooperative Tractor Beam Target widget beside the top-bar electricity display
- Uses the full-color target icon while enabled and a gray icon while disabled
- Click the widget or assign a guarded keyboard shortcut to open or close the control panel
- Toggle automatic recovery at any time
- View the current unassigned-beam count and the result of the last scan
- Run Validate Connections for an immediate ship-wide recovery pass

[h2]Requirements[/h2]

Requires [b]Auto Utilities Mod Framework 1.4.0[/b]. The framework provides the cooperative top-bar widget, theme-compatible managed panel, compatibility handshake, and guarded shortcut assignment used by this release.

[h2]Important Behavior[/h2]

Tractor Beam Auto Connect never changes a Tractor Beam that already has a valid target. Building a new Tractor Beam Target will not pull an existing beam away from its current assignment. The new target becomes available the next time a beam is built, loses its connection, or is manually disconnected.

Manual validation follows the same rule. It repairs missing assignments; it does not rebalance the network.

[h2]In Short[/h2]

You built the beams. You placed the targets. Something forgot the connection.

[b]Tractor Beam Auto Connect remembers it for you.[/b]
